description: Helping millions seamlessly buy insurance
long_description: Acko was founded by Varun Dua, who earlier co-founded insurance portal Coverfox. Acko General Insurance provides insurance products, catering to the needs of the digitally-savvy consumer. The company uses a direct-to-consumer approach for distributing motor insurance, allowing for favourable risk selection and superior underwriting. Acko also offers innovative and bite-sized insurance products such as rider insurance, mobile and appliance protection, ticket cancellation and also group health insurance. We invested in Acko, leading their seed round when they were still pre-launch.

description: Delivering agentic experiences for applications
long_description: Adopt AI is an Agentic AI company focused on helping applications get jobs done for their end users. Adopt AI agentifies applications instantly - by automatically fetching APIs, content, entities, URLs, and other tools from applications and auto-generating a variety of actions (including CRUD actions, navigation, assist, and analytical actions) that work via natural language prompts. Development teams can refine workflows, introduce advanced logic and test via in a sandbox environment before they deploy the agent experience for their end users. Adopt AI's solution enables application companies to rapidly transition to the agentic era, leading to enhanced user experience, greater adoption rates, and reduced customer support costs. By simplifying the interaction layer between humans and applications, Adopt AI streamlines the software development process, expedites feature launches, and envisions a future where AI agents act as the main point of interaction for end users of applications.

description: Skilling the next 100M people towards a livelihood
long_description: Founded in 2019, Airblack is an outcome-focused skilling academy with a focus on short-term courses for livelihood generation. Airback's vision is to move India forward by helping the next 100M people build livelihoods. We partnered with Airblack when they were just a paper plan. It currently operates Airblack Beauty Club, India's largest online beauty academy brand with 35,000+ students in 500+ cities.

description: Bringing people closer to their faith and spirituality digitally
long_description: There has been a strong demand among people of all ages to express their spirituality and devotion online. With AppsForBharat, Prashant Sachan’s vision is to build a spiritual-tech company focused on developing apps to serve these emerging/underserved spiritual and devotional needs of Indian users. He launched the platform in November 2020 as a product studio with a mission to reimagine and digitize the experience of engaging with one’s faith, and offer a unique user experience on people’s smartphones. SriMandir, the first product, aims to be the one-stop virtual destination for devotees to create their personalized shrines, consume devotional content and access a large library of spiritual texts, scriptures and videos.

description: Atlys is a tech startup that makes India visa ready and guarantees on-time visa
long_description: Atlys is on a mission to break down barriers and empower people to travel the world through a simplified solution for visa applications, helping Indians get visas on time to over 100 countries. It transforms a process riddled with anxiety into one with certainty by leveraging over a million data points.

description: Enabling over 4 lakh consumers across 314 cities seamlessly gain credit
long_description: Founded in 2013 by Stanford University’s Graduate School of Business alums Sashank Rishyasringa and Gaurav Hinduja, Axio is a non-banking finance company providing access to loans to SMEs and consumers in a seamless, technology-enabled manner. We invested in Axio at their earliest stages, leading their Seed Round

description: Empowering MSMEs through seamless access to credit
long_description: Founded in 2014, Aye Finance aims to provide innovative and customer-centered financial services to micro and small businesses through its experienced team, effective technology, and robust processes. Aye has been making affordable loans a reality for the historically credit-starved micro-enterprises of India, for whom access to adequate capital has always been a struggle. We are one of the earliest investors in Aye Finance, investing in them at the Seed stage in 2015.

description: Global banking for NRIs
long_description: Belong is an NRI-focused fintech startup founded by a team with deep experience in financial services across wealth, banking and cross-border payments.

description: Activewear brand crafted for Indian women
long_description: Minu is a national level ultimate frisbee player and started Bliss Club with the aim to craft insanely comfortable activewear, specially made for Indian women. She often found herself (and women around her) complaining about recurring issues such as poor fit, improper materials, and lack of functionality when it came to activewear, and therefore decided to jump in. Bliss Club is on a mission to spread happiness through movement and believes that fitness encapsulates how people feel both physically and mentally. Along with its products such as "The Ultimate Leggings", Bliss Club has also built a community of thousands of women across social media, who engage with each other to discuss fitness journeys and motivate each other.

description: Making entertainment accessible to millions
long_description: Launched in 2007 by Ashish Hemrajani, Rajesh Balpande and Parikshit Dar, BookMyShow is India's largest entertainment ticketing portal. Providing avenues across movies, events, plays, concerts and sports, BookMyShow aims to deliver the best entertainment experience to end consumers.

description: On a mission to help employees pick the right employer benefits
long_description: Traditional brokers have a poor onboarding process — they typically provide consumers with large PDF files of the insurance plans and benefit details and leave them to navigate the details and requirements. New employees have to sift through massive printed booklets to determine which health insurance plan and other benefits best fit their unique situations. Founded in 2019 by Ben Hale, Colton Shields, Landon Fielding, Jake Parkinson, Brite is a benefit decision software that helps employees pick the right employer benefits for them and their dependents. The decision tool is integrated with “digital benefit guides” that provide recommendations for employer benefits

description: Bringing bold, customizable Mexican flavors to India
long_description: Founded in 2011, California Burrito is a category-defining fast-casual chain that brought fresh, bold, and customizable Mexican-inspired food to India. With rice bowls, burritos, tacos, and salads made in front of you, the brand blends global appeal with local relevance. It has built a loyal following among millennials and Gen-Z looking for fast, satisfying, wholesome meals. 130+ stores across 5+ cities. Industry-leading NPS. Unit economics that hold up. The numbers reflect what the brand has earned through disciplined, thoughtful execution across cities, formats, and over a decade of building. Led by a mission-driven founder and team with deep operational expertise, California Burrito has done the hard work of proving PMF the right way, one great meal at a time.

description: Making credit accessible to small businesses in 10+ sectors
long_description: CashFlo is an early-stage fintech startup, building a first-of-its-kind private exchange for working capital, addressing the $300B SME credit market in India. CashFlo helps small businesses gain access to collateral-free short-term capital on tap. Founded by Ankur and Dushyant, the CashFlo team brings deep insights in the SME lending space, based on 100+ years of combined experience in financial services. We invested in CashFlo as their first institutional investor at the Seed stage.

description: Serving tea to millions of consumers, exactly the way they like it
long_description: Nitin and Raghav set out on a mission to give every Indian "meri wali chai" (their own cup of tea) through the first Chaayos store in 2012. Indians consume 30 cups of chai for every cup of coffee, and while coffee chains were popping up across the country, it was hard to get good quality tea that matched your own taste outside of home back then. In a market focused on efficiency, Chaayos focuses on customer experience and creates delight through their offerings spanning neighborhood cafes, delivery, and packaged chai for at-home consumption.

description: Social e-commerce for the next billion users
long_description: Founded in 2019 by Angad Kikla and Naisheel Verdhan, CityMall is a social e-commerce startup aiming to help the 200-300 million new to Internet users realize the power of Internet and e-commerce. CityMall has a vision to create India’s largest chain of virtual stores on WhatsApp. Through a network of neighbourhood community leaders, Citymall enables Bharat to experience the convenience of online commerce. We joined hands with CityMall when they were five weeks in after the pivot to this model and were doing around 100 orders daily.

description: Simplifying tax filings for 5M+ users
long_description: Founded by Archit Gupta, Srivatsan Chari and Ankit Solanki in 2011, Clear is India’s leading fintech company helping individuals, tax practitioners and businesses master taxes and save money and time through hassle-free filings. Trusted by over 5M individuals, 80,000 tax practitioners, 600,000 small businesses and 1,500 large businesses, Clear is India's largest tax filing platform.

description: Sneakers crafted for aspirational modern India
long_description: Comet is a lifestyle brand that caters to the unmet aspirations & needs of young Indians who think about footwear beyond its functional aspects. Utkarsh and Dishant are addressing this with affordable India-inspired fashion-forward sneakers and slides that hit the sweet spot between accessibility and exclusivity. Born from a passion for sneakers, Comet's focus on India-centric design and high-quality products has struck a chord with consumers, translating into a burgeoning, loyal community.

description: Integration Platform for AI Agents & LLMs
long_description: Composio is a toolset designed to empower AI agents with seamless interactions with software applications and system tools. Featuring built-in authentication management and support for actions and triggers, Composio enables users to integrate external tools swiftly, helping them go live within hours. Composio enhances AI agents' capabilities, enabling them to execute code, interact with local systems, and integrate with over 200 external tools, thus simplifying complex integration tasks and letting users focus on their primary objectives. It also supports custom tool development, allowing developers to build tailored solutions.

description: Pure, fresh and minimally processed essentials delivered everyday
long_description: Country Delight is India's largest direct to consumer fresh daily essentials brand. The company's core product offering is farm-fresh milk which is delivered daily to consumers. The company follows a full-stack approach and owns sourcing, processing, and distribution. Over time, the company has added other daily essentials such as curd, bread, eggs, paneer, ghee, and fruits and vegetables to its portfolio which ride on the same distribution channel. Country Delight serves ~150k customers every day across the top 3 cities in India.

description: Helping doctors provide holistic care
long_description: Started as a patient engagement and management medium for doctors, Curelink now serves as a platform to help doctors and medical care providers reach patients through WhatsApp. It offers hassle-free and quick responses to queries and curated care plans, including labour management, mental health and garb sanskar sessions to pregnant women while supporting mothers post-partum with personalised diet plans, skincare guide, etc providing the necessary care, tips for PCOS patients all under one roof.

description: Driving efficiency improvement through digital transformation
long_description: Detect Technologies, a company incorporated in 23rd February 2016 and incubated at Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), Madras, provides smart solutions powered by indigenously researched advanced technologies for asset monitoring in large manufacturing industries and for complex processes. The founders of the company have deep technical expertise in Non-Destructive Evaluation, and they range from the best professors in India, highly qualified industrial professionals to young motivated engineers from premiere institutes. With innovation and technology at its core, Detect Technologies offers solutions to bring complete intelligence and automation in asset monitoring, thereby enabling its clients to enhance their throughput and productivity. We invested in Detect in 2018, leading the pre Series A round

description: Specialised AI agents for hospitality, from back office to guest experience
long_description: Dextr AI provides a specialised AI workforce for the hospitality industry, with agents spanning use cases from back-office operations to guest experience. Its forward-deployed approach streamlines implementation by pairing each business with AI strategists and engineers who work closely with operators to identify high-ROI opportunities, then design, build, and deploy agents tailored to their workflows. As the hospitality industry navigates persistent staffing pressures, Dextr AI helps businesses absorb operational complexity by automating repetitive, time-consuming work and embedding efficiency into day-to-day operations. In a sector where the guest experience depends on human connection, Dextr AI creates value by taking care of the work behind the scenes and giving teams more time to focus on guests, service, and higher-value decisions.

description: On a mission to redefine how Indians invest and grow their wealth
long_description: Established in April 2021 by former IIFL Wealth Senior Managing Partners—Sandeep Jethwani, Vaibhav Porwal and Sahil Contractor—dezerv.will help emerging affluent Indians invest like experts. Via their unique Integrated Portfolio Approach (IPA) combined with white-glove expert advisory, dezerv. will help users maximize returns while controlling the downside by providing the right portfolio mix. It will also unlock access to new asset classes, currently available only to high net worth individuals. A majority of working professionals in India today lack adequate access to differentiated wealth-tech solutions and expert investing approaches and are in need of guidance on their portfolios and investments. With over 15 years’ of experience each in the wealth management industry, Sandeep, Sahil and Vaibhav realized this market gap and set up dezerv. as a one-of-a-kind investing platform to disrupt the current invest-tech market.

description: Becoming the 'Google Maps' for companies to scale
long_description: Drivetrain helps businesses scale and achieve their targets predictably. With only a few organizations identifying performance issues before they hit financials, timely response is critical. Drivetrain’s platform helps finance teams build integrated plans, budgets and forecasts, track their progress against targets, and identify bottlenecks to growth.

description: Managing sales commissions on autopilot
long_description: Everstage is a modern, no-code platform to automate commissions and motivate sales teams with real-time visibility and insights on their commissions. It enables reps with real-time tracking of commissions and performance data. With Everstage statements, reps will know the exact commission they got paid for each deal. They will also be able to clearly attribute commissions for different plan criteria and spiff (Sales Performance Incentive Fund) programs.

description: Goal driven augmented analytics platform for marketers
long_description: Factors.ai is a next-generation augmented marketing analytics platform which empowers marketers to make better decisions. Factors.ai powers better analytics through its search based goal-driven marketing analytics product that automatically finds insights on the data and is as easy to use as a "Google Search". The company unifies data across systems and and delivers relevant personalized insights on key metrics, trends, outliers to the marketer through powerful Machine Learning based algorithms. Impressed with the team's deep undersatnding of the space, we joined hands with them as they started building the product in the first half of 2020.

description: India's first neo-bank for teenagers
long_description: FamApp by Trio (formerly FamPay) focuses on financial inclusion of the next generation by providing UPI & card payments. FamApp by Trio's Spending Account, FamX, helps everyone save, spend, earn and learn everything about money - all in one app.

description: Logistics SaaS Platform for predictive visibility
long_description: Fareye is changing the way logistics companies get visibility on their shipments across the world. The company offers a visibility platform for long and short haul transport that provides drag and drop functionality to create operational workflows suitable for any customer’s logistics processes. FarEye delivers a simplified, innovative, and intuitive experience across the entire logistics ecosystem through real-time visibility, multi-enterprise collaboration, and last-mile execution, and enables the world's leading enterprises to reduce delivery times and increase on time deliveries. Currently Fareye serves more than 150 enterprises across 20 countries including companies such as DHL, Amway, Hilti, Domino's, and Walmart. We partnered with Fareye as the lead investor in their Series A round and have also backed them in their follow on rounds.

description: Saas enabled agile manufacturing marketplace for fashion brands
long_description: Founded by Pawan Gupta and Abhishek Sharma in 2020, Fashinza is a Saas enabled agile manufacturing marketplace for fashion brands. Their vision is to democratise the fashion supply chain to make it faster, more flexible, and sustainable using technology and machine learning. Fashinza helps brands reduce inventory forecasting errors and produce goods with complete transparency and minimal effort. Excited by Pawan and Abhishek's experience building and scaling ventures, we invested in the business in the early days when the idea had just been conceptualized.

description: India's largest shopping destination for baby and kids' products
long_description: Founded in 2010 by Supam Maheshwari and Amitava Saha, FirstCry is India's largest destination for baby and kids products. It offers a wide range of brands for babies, kids and moms across its website and 400+ franchisee stores. We had partnered with FirstCry a few weeks after they had gone live and were doing ~100 orders per day.

description: Building mobile games for the Indian audience
long_description: Flecks Labs' mission is to create highly social games that engage players on platforms beyond traditional app stores.

description: Powerful invoicing and accounting for the Indian SMB owner
long_description: FloBiz is India's fastest growing SMB digitisation startup that aims to accelerate the growth of small & medium enterprises. Founded in 2019 by IIT & BITS alumni, FloBiz launched its flagship product MyBillBook in early 2020 and it has become one of the top business apps in India on the Google Play Store.

description: India’s leading peer-to-peer online commerce platform
long_description: FreeUp is India’s leading peer-to-peer online commerce platform where anyone can sell their pre-loved goods, unused goods or goods that they make at home. By combining gamification and social connection with the scale and ease of e-commerce, FreeUp makes buying and selling amongst individuals simple, safe, and fun. It services 26,000+ pin codes across India, providing doorstep pickup and delivery for a wide array of products, including fashion, kids, home, beauty, books, gadgets, and more.

description: Dating for the next billion users
long_description: FRND aims to enable the next billion internet users to find a romantic match through a network of matchmakers, over audio. Once a match has been found, FRND provides a safe and fun place for the virtual dates to take place. The key focus is on women privacy and security, while building a product that caters to the cultural sensibilities of the users. We invested in Frnd when they had 3000 active downloads

description: AI Powered Business Immigration
long_description: Gale uses AI to automate the entire H-1B application and compliance process for US employers, with licensed attorneys ensuring accuracy at all steps. Gale is disrupting the $10B immigration services market, starting with US H-1Bs. They have simplified the visa application process to a web form, streamlined compliance, and can integrate with HR systems - saving teams time, money and headaches. By using AI and automation, Gale enables their lawyers to maintain quality but be 3x as efficient. This allows them to deliver a superior user experience, decrease costs and reduce visa turn-around times.

description: Personal robotics for everyone
long_description: General Autonomy is a robotics and AI company building affordable robots for everyday chores.

description: World's leading technology platform for CSR, Volunteering, & Sustainability
long_description: Founded in 2014, Goodera is a leading cloud platform to provide visibility for all CSR, volunteering, and sustainability measures in the company.It helps you collect and analyze data from across the world in local languages, understand the impact at the last mile in real-time, provides dashboards for reporting to all your stakeholders and engages employees in volunteering. Goodera measures its success through the beneficiaries it has empowered. Since inception, the company has touched the lives of 75 Mn+ beneficiaries across 90+ countries serving 200+ corporations (25 in Fortune 100 customers). We partnered with Goodera when they were at ~75 customers and had just crossed $2M in ARR.

description: Agentic Voice AI for India's BFSI
long_description: GreyLabs AI is transforming customer engagement across India's banking and financial services sector through its Voice AI Agent Platform. GreyLabs AI's platform goes beyond traditional automation by offering BFSI-tuned agents that seamlessly blend AI efficiency with human empathy, featuring natively multilingual capabilities. Their comprehensive solution handles everything from sales and customer service to collections and renewals, while maintaining the accuracy, compliance, and empathy that financial services demand.

description: AI + IoT solutions for water management
long_description: Over the past few years, there has been an explosion in unstructured data across manufacturing industries driven by affordable sensors and instrumentation. Founded in 2015, HABER is focused on helping its customers spend less time collecting and analyzing this data and spend more time using HABER’s platform to drive efficiency, identify issues before they happen, and uncover hidden potential. HABER’s platform transforms raw data into actionable intelligence driving visibility in the form of intuitive dashboards, analysis, and scorecards available enterprise-wide in real-time from anywhere. While Haber today has over 50 installations at 30 unique companies, we had invested in Haber at the concept stage.​

description: Making fashion inclusive and accessible for Indian women
long_description: Founded in 2012 by Tanvi Malik and Shivani Poddar, High Street Essentials (HSE) owns and operates two brands - FabAlley and Indya, united by a common mission to make great design accessible to all Indian women and to lead the way towards a more inclusive and fashion forward world. FabAlley and Indya are leading women's fast fashion brands specialising in affordable western wear and innovative ethnic-fusion wear respectively. HSE retails it's products across online platforms and ~500 offline touch-points.

description: India's largest B2B marketplace
long_description: Founded by Dinesh Agarwal and Brijesh Agrawal in 1996, IndiaMART Intermesh Limited (NSE: INDIAMART) is India's largest B2B marketplace, with over 60% market share. Founded with the mission “to make doing-business easy”, the company operates a web and app based platform that matches buyers and suppliers. The platform has 6 M+ supplier listings for 68 M products across 100K+ categories and 107 M+ registered buyers. They generate revenue primarily through the sale of subscription packages for priority listing.

description: B2B e-commerce platform
long_description: Industry Buying is a leading B2B e-commerce marketplace for industrial MRO and indirect materials used by large and small businesses. Industrybuying.com participates in 3 distinct market segments - SME Ecommerce via its Joint venture with MonotaRO Japan, Large Enterprise Marketplace Aggregation, and B2B e-commerce SaaS software services.

description: Here to create a million millionaires
long_description: We are on a mission to create millionaires! We are here to create a new world order; one in which ESOPs are real and operators are recognized for the risk you have taken. Our goal is to become the wealth manager for the next generation of millennials - by unlocking liquidity for ESOPs within the startup ecosystem

description: Enabling Indians to travel at the best prices
long_description: Launched in 2007, ixigo is a technology company focused on empowering Indian travellers to plan, book and manage their trips by leveraging artificial intelligence, machine learning and data science led innovations. The OTA platform allows travellers to book train, flight & bus tickets, hotels and cabs, while providing travel utility tools and services developed using in-house proprietary algorithms and crowd-sourced information, including train PNR status and confirmation predictions, train running status updates and predictions, flight status updates, bus running status, pricing and availability alerts, deal discovery, destination content, personalized recommendations, instant fare alerts and automated customer support services.

description: Transforming Aerospace Supply Chains via Software-Defined Precision Manufacturing
long_description: Jeh Aerospace specializes in high-precision aerospace and defense manufacturing, driven by software-defined manufacturing technology. Headquartered in Atlanta, US, with state-of-the-art facilities and robust production capacities in Hyderabad, India, Jeh delivers flight-critical components with unmatched quality and speed. Founded by Vishal R. Sanghavi and Venkatesh Mudragalla, Jeh builds global resilience through top talent and cutting-edge technology, setting a benchmark for global aerospace supply chains.

description: Reimagining financial products for India
long_description: Jodo is a mission-oriented fin-tech startup building a suite of carefully tailored financial products to fulfill the aspirations and needs of middle-income households in urban India. Jodo is started by three cofounders, who have a pedigreed education background and relevant professional experience in financial services. More importantly, they come from a similar background as the customer segment they are serving, and have done extensive customer research to understands the needs of the customer. We invested in Jodo at a pre launch stage to help them realise this mission.

description: Helping companies more accurately hire the right people for the right jobs
long_description: Hiring is a complicated set of decisions subject to different opinions and typically made with little data. Recruiters spend considerable time and effort trying to find and hire the best candidates based on rigid and unproven factors. Daniel Ash, Founder and CEO, learned early in his career what it felt like to be in a job that wasn’t a match. At Journeyfront, he has built a solid team, leveraging Nick Lyon’s product expertise, Mike Margett’s technical know-how and Erik Porfeli’s background in research, with the capability to scale and solve the problem. Journeyfront’s mission is to unleash the potential of the world’s workforce by helping companies more accurately hire the right people for the right jobs. It uses customer-specific data to identify candidates that are most likely to succeed and find satisfaction in their roles.

description: Connecting 100 m users quarterly to more than 29 million listings
long_description: Founded by V.S.S. Mani in 1996, Justdial is India’s local search destination, both online and over the telephone. It provides fast, free, reliable and comprehensive information to its users across across internet, mobile internet, telephone (voice) and text (SMS) platforms. Justdial's mission is to provide fast, free, reliable and comprehensive information to our users and connect buyers to sellers.

description: Simplifying digital asset self custody
On a mission to reimagine primary care and health insurance in India
long_description: Established in 2018, by Mayank Kale, Ryan Singh, and Amrit Singh, Loop Health is reimagining primary care and health insurance in India. Corporate group health insurance (benefits) is a largely underpenetrated segment in the country—with little differentiation between providers and limited utilization by employees. Loop focuses on health outcomes - and allows companies to offer employees health insurance from prominent insurers bundled with instant, free primary care. Each member is assigned a dedicated medical advisor for themselves and their family and can consult Loop’s panel of experienced doctors over the phone or video within minutes. There is guidance along the entire healthcare journey – across consultations, discounted test booking, planning hospitalization, and making claims.

description: India’s largest network of community cancer centres
long_description: M|O|C is a concept turned enterprise and a pioneering chain of community cancer centres that relentlessly works to simplify journey for cancer patients by building an ecosystem that embodies crucial aspects like proximity and affordability. As of March 2025, the network includes 24 centres across western and central India, as well as in Tanzania. The team consists of 47 medical and hematology oncologists, who have collectively treated over 4.5 lakh cancer patients to date.

description: NBFC specializing in used commercial and passenger vehicle financing
long_description: Mahaveer Finance India Limited, established in 1981, is a Chennai-based Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) specializing in used commercial vehicle financing for retail customers, first-time buyers, and small fleet operators across South India. The company operates over 80 branches across five states and territories, serving more than 20,000 active customers with a focus on underserved Tier 2-5 markets. With over four decades of profitable operations, Mahaveer Finance has established a diversified funding base comprising more than 40 lender relationships and maintains a track record of conservative lending practices and superior asset quality.

description: India's largest OTA
long_description: Founded by Deep Kalra and Rajesh Magow, MakeMyTrip.com is India’s largest online travel company. Nurtured from the seed of a single great idea - to empower the traveller - MakeMyTrip went on to pioneer the entire online travel industry in India. Today, MakeMyTrip is much more than just a travel portal or a famous pioneering brand - it is a one-stop-travel-shop that offers the broadest selection of travel products and services in India

description: Maxim AI is an enterprise-grade evaluation and observability platform for generative AI applications.
long_description: Maxim AI is a generative AI evaluation and observability platform for modern AI applications. The company streamlines the entire AI development lifecycle from design to production, enabling faster, reliable, and high-quality deployment of AI across organizations. Founded in 2023 by Google-Postman duo Vaibhavi Gangwar and Akshay Deo, Maxim AI operates globally with offices in India and the US. In its seed round, the company raised $3 million in funding from Elevation Capital and marquee angel investors, including founders of Postman, Chargebee, Groww, Razorpay, Media.net among others.

description: India’s only true e-commerce marketplace - Democratising Internet Commerce for Everyone
long_description: Founded by Vidit Aatrey and Sanjeev Barnwal in 2015, Meesho is a social commerce platform that enables individuals and small businesses to start their online stores via social media channels such as Whatsapp and Facebook. Along with providing access to a wide catalog across categories such as apparel, home & kitchen and personal care, Meesho empowers these micro-entrepreneurs by enabling order placement, last mile logistics and payments. Meesho has enabled more than 5 mn micro-entrepreneurs till date. We partnered with Meesho in the early days after they had pivoted to the current model.

description: Building an alternate higher-ed model for the India of tomorrow
long_description: Mesa School of Business, founded by Harvard and Kellogg alumni, is on a mission: to redefine leadership for India's startup era. Why Mesa? We're committed to nurturing disruptive thinkers and transformative leaders. Our first offering, the 12-month PGP in Startup Leadership, blends real-world projects with academic rigour, mentored by startup CXOs. This isn't just another MBA; it's a career catalyst that will unlock doors in India's thriving startup scene. Join us and become the entrepreneurial leader India needs.

description: Transforming B2B BNPL
long_description: Mintifi partners with leading brands and enables inventory financing for their distributors and retailers. Traditional lending products do not meet the immediate, short-term needs of SMEs, which constitute ~80% of their total financing needs. Mintifi provides credit on tap to these SMEs through its plug and play platform, which makes use of a proprietary credit underwriting technology and real-time digital processing, .

description: Helping Indians live healthier, fulfilling lives
long_description: Founded in 2019 by Revant Bhate and Dhyanesh Shah, Mosaic Wellness is a multi-brand consumer goods company owned and operated under one house, with each of its brands working together towards one mission: to help Indians lead a more fulfilling life surrounded by wellness and grace. Mosaic's first two brands - Man Matters and Bodywise are digital health clinics for men and women respectively and offer a wide range of consumer products across categories such as hair, skin, weight, sexual wellness, etc. coupled with doctor consultations. The uniqueness and relevance of Mosaic's vision coupled with demonstrated excellence by both founders in operating and investing roles in the past made us super excited to partner with the company at the paper-plan stage.

description: Building an AI-enabled voice-over startup
long_description: Murf.ai was founded in October 2020 by IIT-Kharagpur batchmates Sneha Roy, Ankur Edkie, and Divyanshu Pandey. It is an AI-enabled SaaS tool that allows users to generate “human-like” voiceovers for videos and slideshows—without hiring a voice artist or using any complex recording equipment. With videos taking over the internet, the need to create audio and video content at scale is bigger than ever. Most companies outsource the voice overs required, which are expensive, time-consuming and cumbersome to produce. The team at Murf.ai is on a mission to integrate the latest AI and voice technologies to generate realistic, human-sounding voice overs for enterprises, SMBs and content creators globally

description: Largest stock exchange in India
long_description: Established in 1992, National Stock Exchange of India Limited is the leading stock exchange of India. It is the first dematerialized electronic exchange in the country that is catalyzing India's growth story by creating investment opportunities, enabling access and empowering stakeholders.

description: Enabling Document Workflow Automation at Scale
long_description: Nanonets gives organizations the ability to write their own business rules, connect to varied business data sources, and update internal systems to automate document workflows and financial controls. The platform keeps learning from every document it sees and organizations can automate an end-to-end process within hours, helping them speed up their operations and their employees do more with their time.

description: Revolutionizing home buying and rentals
long_description: NoBroker is India's largest C2C real estate marketplace for residential and commercial properties across rental and sale transactions. The platform eliminates brokers or agents from real estate transactions by connecting transacting parties directly. It also provides related services like rental agreements, packers and movers, rent-pay, insurance etc. We believed in their vision of using technology to eliminate middlemen from real estate transactions who charge a commission of up to 20% primarily due to information asymmetry, and invested in NoBroker when they were operating in only 15 neighbourhoods of Mumbai with less than 50 new listings per day.

description: India's leading full stack financial services company
long_description: Founded in 2006 by Vijay Shekhar Sharma, Paytm is India's leading financial services company that offers full-stack payments & financial solutions to consumers, offline merchants and online platforms. The company is on a mission to bring half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy through payments, commerce, banking, investments, and financial services.

description: Building Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) systems tailored to mission specific requirements.
long_description: PierSight, founded by ex-ISRO scientist, Gaurav Seth, builds application-specific Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) systems, that deliver persistent, all-weather, day-and-night intelligence for maritime, defence, and other domains. Its portfolio includes Varuna, a satellite constellation built for persistent maritime surveillance, and Vidura, a plug-and-play SAR payload that can be mounted on UAV platforms for foliage-penetrating surveillance. The company is also part of the consortium selected to build India's first Earth Observation constellation under the country's public-private partnership model.

description: Building addictive casual games for the world
long_description: Playsimple is India's leading gaming company that develops social-casual games targeting global markets, especially English speaking countries like US, UK, Canada, Australia and New Zealand. It is a global leader in the word gaming genre of casual games. It has multiple successful titles in its portfolio such as Crossword and Word Trip. We invested in Playsimple when they had only 2 titles and an annual revenue of USD 5 million.

description: Pharmacy-first rapid medicine delivery. Filling prescriptions in minutes.
long_description: Plazza is building a modern pharmacy network that India can finally trust to meet every medical need, where medicine availability is the norm versus the exception. Unlike older eCommerce business models in this category, Plazza is taking a hyperlocal approach to offer fast fulfillment while ensuring high fill-rates and value pricing to become the go-to app for both acute and chronic use-cases. Every Plazza store has an inventory of 40,000+ SKUs against the 5,000 for a conventional pharmacy of the same size. This inventory is curated by Plazza’s AI-powered algorithmic engine that assesses every neighborhood’s specific requirements through continual learning. This approach enables the best-in-class prescription fill rates of up to 95%. A combination of hyperlocal fulfillment and fast moving inventory allows Plazza to offer value pricing to customers and the long term vision is to create India’s lowest cost pharma fulfillment network.

description: Empowering product marketers in mobile-first companies to build app experiences
long_description: Plotline is a Mobile Adoption OS, built for consumer apps. Plotline empowers product marketing teams to tailor app experiences to each user’s behaviours and preferences. With a powerful no-code platform that allows growth marketers to craft and launch tailored UX campaigns, Plotline is now enabling consumer brands across the globe to skyrocket their user adoption and engagement rates.

description: Enabling mass adoption of Ethereum
long_description: Polygon is the leading platform for Ethereum scaling and infrastructure development. Its growing suite of products offers developers easy access to all major scaling and infrastructure solutions. Polygon’s scaling solutions have seen widespread adoption with 7,000+ applications hosted, 1B+ total transactions processed, ~130M+ unique user addresses, and $5B+ in assets secured.

description: Enabling accelerated breakthroughs for materials R&D teams
long_description: Polymerize is a fast growing material informatics company based out of Singapore and India. Founded in 2020, Polymerize is currently serving large scale chemical companies across multiple geographies. Polymerize’s platform enables R&D teams to collaborate and effectively manage all of their experimental data, design new experiments and get AI based recommendations for new formulations or alternative ingredients with desired properties. The ever increasing demand for high performance materials to support advancements across industries such as electric mobility, circular economy, aviation, energy, healthcare etc is pushing the companies to innovate & develop materials faster. And, the material companies need to identify the right formulations which will meet their objectives. The current process of formulation development is iterative, manual, time & cost intensive and can take anywhere from several months to a few years. Polymerize, with their software is shortening this development time significantly and helping R&D achieve cost savings while generating new formulations with better outcomes.

description: Online dispute resolution platform
long_description: Founded in 2017 by Bhaven Shah, Namita Shah, and Aman Sanghavi, Presolv360 is India's leading online dispute resolution (ODR) platform. Anchored in the principles of neutrality, accessibility, innovation, and party-centricity, Presolv360 provides comprehensive ODR solutions including arbitration, mediation, and negotiation that empower disputing parties from remote locations and diverse socio-economic backgrounds to resolve disputes efficiently and securely.

description: Helping companies to bridge the gap between strategy and execution
long_description: Profit.co, an enterprise-class SaaS platform headquartered in Fremont, California, USA, is on a mission to bridge the gap between strategy and execution for organizations worldwide. We understand the vital role of measuring success in today's business landscape and provide the tools to help companies achieve it. With a wealth of experience in OKRs and other methodologies spanning over three decades, our founder's vision was to create an all-in-one strategy execution platform that seamlessly integrates into any organization. Our platform offers products to manage Strategy, Tasks, OKRs, Employee performance, and engagement. Our user-friendly platform ensures that goals are clear, tasks are efficiently managed, strategies are aligned, and employees are engaged and developed. What sets us apart is our commitment to customer success by offering 24x7 live support and an outcome-focused OKR Coaching and Consulting program to ensure our customers consistently achieve their goals. We've earned the trust of a broad spectrum of companies, ranging from startups to Fortune 500 companies. Our impact extends across 25 countries, serving many sectors, including technology, finance, telecom, manufacturing, retail, and government.

description: Enabling Knowledge Creators to build their Communities
long_description: Rigi is on a mission to democratise the knowledge economy by enabling creators to own their audience, engage with them more deeply through private communities, and subsequently monetise them v/s being reliant on social platforms. Using the Rigi app, creators can create and manage their paid communities (hosted on Rigi app / platforms such as WhatsApp & Telegram), manage renewals, integrate with social platforms and create new paid products - locked messages, webinars, courses etc. Rigi ensures that these services are then available to end users through a robust and integrated tech infrastructure which enhances customer experience and therefore improves end-user retention for the creators. Rigi started out with a focus on the Indian market, and has now started expanding globally, starting with Indonesia.

description: Easy & hassle-free gold loans
long_description: Rupeek is a fintech firm in the gold lending space in India. Started in 2015 as an asset-backed lending marketplace, Rupeek is disrupting traditional brick-and-mortar lending models. Rupeek leverages technology to operate with a branchless model and passes the benefit of lower operational costs to the end customer. Rupeek is on a mission to bring transparency in the gold loans lending space and contributing to the India growth story by monetizing India’s idle gold to generate liquidity which will increase economic activity.

description: Makeup of choice for bold & independent Indian women
long_description: Vineeta and Kaushik set out to make beauty accessible for Indian women in 2012 as FAB BAG (beauty and grooming subscription box). On speaking to their users, they realized that there was a bigger gap in product v/s distribution and started building SUGAR in 2016. With a cruelty-free range that is high on style and higher on performance, SUGAR is obsessed with crafting products that are a perfect match for every Indian skin-tone all throughout the year. Over the last few years, SUGAR has become a cult favorite amongst Gen-Z and millennials and is one of the fastest-growing premium beauty brands in the country. SUGAR started out as an internet-first brand and has now expanded its presence to 10,000+ retail outlets across 130+ cities as well.

description: Pro trading on mobile
long_description: Sahi is an AI-native broker completely re-imagining trading and investing for retail users in India. Incumbents have solved access and execution, i.e. making it frictionless to place a trade. Sahi is going after the harder, unsolved problem: what to trade and where to invest, actively aided by in-house charts, real-time AI intelligence, and workflows.

description: A household-focused lender, catering to the aspirations of rural India
long_description: SarvaGram is building India’s first household-centric, high-touch and high-tech lending platform, to meet the growing aspirations of rural India. The company focuses on the missing middle between microfinance and formal banking. With their focused location selection, household-level view of incomes and liabilities, and on-ground presence, SarvaGram helps rural lenders enhance their income generation capacity by offering productive credit.

description: New age credit card with a strong travel centric value proposition
long_description: Scapia is building a new age consumer credit company with a strong travel centric value proposition. Their first product is a credit card focused on travel rewards - users can redeem Scapia coins and book travel experiences, flights, stays on the app.

description: The World's First Meme-Based Dating App
long_description: Schmooze an AI-powered meme-based dating app to reinvent how Gen-Z connects in the digital age. Schmooze was born out of a simple yet powerful insight: Gen-Z craves deeper connections that go beyond surface-level appearances. By leveraging the universal language of memes — and AI — Schmooze is helping users make meaningful connections based on shared humor, personality traits, and interests. In just 10 months since its launch in India, Schmooze has attracted over 1 million users and has witnessed a staggering 900 million meme swipes.

description: India’s First Edutainment OTT Platform
long_description: Seekho is India's first Edutainment OTT platform, on its mission to unify knowledge & entertainment to empower the masses! The platform offers engaging bite-sized videos around Technology, money, and business categories in regional Indian languages. The content is created by experts and is professionally curated to deliver an exclusive and fun learning experience. Being built by a strong team of IIT Kanpur Alumni, they are growing fast while expanding to more categories and geographies to eventually become ‘Netflix for Learning’ for the world!

description: Bharat's gateway to the internet
long_description: ShareChat is India's first homegrown social network serving the new internet users who access content primarily in their regional languages. The company operates two apps; ShareChat which is a multimedia social network and Moj, which is a short-form video creation and sharing platform. Both these platforms allow users to consume and share content in their local languages as well as communicate with their friends and favourite content creators. When we first invested in ShareChat, they were at 4000 monthly active users. We invested in the team's vision to build out a social platform for these users which they knew intimately given their own backgrounds.

description: Making D2C-commerce as easy as selling on marketplaces
long_description: Founded by Harmin Shah and Rishabh Verma, ShopDeck is a platform designed to assist sellers in creating their e-commerce store/website. It help with logistics management, secure payments system, and all the necessary tools for a business to effectively sell online. There are ~500k-1M sellers who sell on marketplaces and have a strong aspiration to build their brand direct-to-consumers (D2C) as well. ShopDeck is helping them take their first steps on the path to creating their brand, which is every seller's long-term aspiration.

description: Reimagining B2B cross-border payments for SMBs
long_description: Skydo is a B2B cross-border payments platform for SMBs, founded by Srivatsan (ex-Rupeek, Ola) and Movin (ex-PhonePe, Meesho). Skydo makes global payment collections a seamless and touch-free experience for exporters. Starting with the large and fast-growing Indian services SMBs, Skydo delivers customers a low-cost pricing and easy regulatory compliance. We invested in Skydo in 2022, leading their seed round when they were still pre-launch.

description: On-demand home services to empower urban households
long_description: Founded in 2024 by Aayush Agarwal, Snabbit is India’s first Quick-Service App offering on-demand home services. With a hyperlocal network operating in dense residential clusters, Snabbit guarantees quality and speed, providing trusted and trained experts who arrive within minutes. Snabbit takes a full-stack approach to sourcing, training, and managing experts. Combined with an innovative time-based pricing model, Snabbit simplifies daily life for urban families while creating respectable, well-paying opportunities for a workforce that has long been fragmented and unorganized.

description: Powering India with renewable energy
long_description: SolarSquare designs, installs and finances rooftop solar systems for homes. In addition, the company also provides rooftop solar solutions for housing societies and commercial establishments. In the last 2 years the company has solarised close to 5,000 homes, helping owners save on average Rs. 40,000 per year in electricity bills. Alongside savings, each home also offsets 4 metric tons of CO2 emissions per year by switching to cleaner solar power.

description: Personal AI teacher
long_description: SpeakX is an innovative Edtech platform that is revolutionizing English learning for adults and children! Their personalised AI-powered tutor enhances speaking skills, empowering learners to overcome communication barriers through interactive and immersive conversations. The platform uses Speech Technology and large language models (LLM) to create personalized AI tutors, making English learning fun and interactive.

description: Full stack, tech-enabled pre-owned car platform
long_description: Founded in 2015 by Niraj Singh, Mohit Gupta and Ramanshu Mahaur, Spinny is a full stack, tech-enabled pre-owned car platform. Through its full stack, O2O model, Spinny offers high quality pre-owned vehicles at an affordable price to customers thus easing their purchase journey.

description: Providing transformative compliance automation solutions
long_description: Sprinto is a compliance automation platform that helps fast growing SaaS companies obtain compliances such as SOC 2, ISO27001, GDPR, HIPAA etc., in a quick and hassle-free manner. Obtaining these certifications helps close enterprise deals and pass vendor security assessments easily and Sprinto helps it customers meet these requirements 10x faster.

description: AI driven RMM + PSA software for MSPs and internal teams
long_description: Founded in 2020, SuperOps is building a disruptive AI-driven software that helps managed service providers (MSPs) and internal IT teams to help them automate processes, drive revenue, and scale their businesses. The team's vision is to create new age Remote monitoring and management (RMM) and Professional Services Automation (PSA) tools with true-AI capabilities that can help MSPs and IT professionals to efficiently manage their business needs. In a space with legacy products, the team's in-depth experience and fresh ideas gave us the confidence to partner with them before they had started building out the product

description: India’s leading food delivery and quick commerce platform
long_description: Founded in 2014 by Sriharsha Majety, Nandan Reddy and Rahul Jamini, Swiggy is India’s leading on-demand delivery platform with a vision to elevate the quality of life for the urban consumer by offering unparalleled convenience. It connects consumers to hundreds of thousands of restaurants and stores in over 500 cities. Using innovative technology, Swiggy provides a hassle-free, fast and reliable delivery experience. Every order delivered by Swiggy’s fleet of independent delivery partners ensures a host of customer-centric features like lightning fast delivery, no minimum order value, live order tracking, and 24/7 customer support. Swiggy team’s customer obsession was very evident, even in their early days, when Swiggy was just a few weeks old and was live only in Koramangala, and that is when we decided to partner.

description: AI-Powered Customer Engagement for Life Sciences
long_description: Founded in 2024, Synthio Labs is building the operating system for modern life sciences teams: a clinical-grade conversational AI platform designed to support every clinician and patient at scale. Pharma companies spend over $30B every year trying to engage their customers, yet outreach remains manual, fragmented, and slow, contributing to treatment drop-off rates that can reach 50% in long-term conditions. The industry doesn’t just need more engagement - it needs better, faster, and more secure and compliant engagement. Synthio’s AI OS brings together voice, data, and intelligence across three core products: Jarvis - a voice AI copilot built for field teams. Ather - a multimodal engine powering omnichannel physician and patient conversations. Simulation Studio - digital twins of clinicians that help teams test strategies and plan with precision. All three products are built on HIPAA-compliant, SOC2-ready infrastructure, with real-time reasoning, millisecond-level data access, and strict content-guardrails to ensure 100% traceability. Their early adopters include top 10 pharma and leading D2C healthcare companies who are reimagining how they support clinicians and patients. Synthio Labs is defining the next generation of customer engagement infrastructure for life sciences, bringing consumer-grade intelligence to an industry ready for transformation.

description: India's largest D2C fan merchandise & casual-wear destination
long_description: Founded in 2013, and based out of Mumbai, The Souled Store is India’s largest fan merchandise destination and a casual-wear brand. The company has partnered with 150+ pop culture franchisees and sports teams including Disney, Marvel, WWE, Game of Thrones, Looney Tunes, Mumbai Indians, Chennai Super Kings and Liverpool FC. It manufactures products for both men and women, spanning T-Shirts, Sweatshirts, Shirts, Polos, Bottom wear, etc. Over the last 2-3 years, the company has broadened its product portfolio to non-licensed casual wear / basics, which it sells under its own brand. The company retails its products largely through its own channels (web, app and store) and considers being direct-to-consumer core to its DNA as it enables them to drive customer retention and control working capital tightly.

description: Outcome focused, end to end learning platform for K-12
long_description: Toppr provides an end to end K-12 learning platform which focuses on learning outcomes. It is an after-school learning application that covers the school curriculum and entrance examination requirements in a 360 degree way. Trusted by paretns and children, the product currently has more than 50 mn users on a monthly basis. We were the first institutional investors in Toppr in 2014.

description: Leading platform for tracking startups and private companies
long_description: Founded in 2013 by Neha SIngh and Abhishek Goyal, Tracxn is one of the world’s largest platforms for tracking startups and private companies spread across 300+ technology sectors and 800+ emerging themes, with dedicated coverage on 30+ countries. It is powered by a unique combination of human analysts and artificial intelligence technology that scans through billions of data points to build one of the most relevant data intelligence platforms.

description: Providing affordable luxury to travellers
long_description: Treebo Hotels is India's most-loved branded chain of budget hotels on a mission to guarantee affordable luxury. India's budget hotel market is large and highly fragmented leading to poor traveller experience and low ROI for hotel owners. Treebo partners with existing budget hotels to provide travellers with reliable comfortable accomodation at affordable prices along with helping hotel partners earn more from their properties. We invested in Treebo when it was just a paper plan since we had very high conviction in the team as well as the differentiated asset light, yet full-stack model they wanted to pursue.

description: Re-imagining gaming Communities
long_description: Turnip aspires to become synonymous with game live streaming on mobile devices. The platform enables mobile device gamers to stream live gameplay at the ease of a couple of clicks from their mobile screens. For fans, it is a medium to view fun-packed streams and engage with their favourite streamers more intimately and personally, than ever before. We met Turnip first when it was a pre-product stage idea and we resonated with the the team's vision that we partnered with them just a couple of days after our first chat.

description: India's leading education platform
long_description: Founded in 2015 by Gaurav Munjal, Roman Saini and Hemesh Singh, Unacademy's vision is to partner with the brightest minds and have courses on every possible topic in multiple languages so the whole world can benefit from these courses. Unacademy offers a wide range of courses, which includes test-prep, K-12, personal development, and other life skills.

description: Building feature and experience-rich consumer credit for India
long_description: Contextual consumer credit is a massive opportunity in India and offers huge scope for innovation. For example, less than 15% Indian adults are credit-active, with less than 5% holding a credit card. Through Uni, Nitin, Laxmikant and Prateek’s aim is to bring the benefits of flexible credit to the Indian masses, starting with the one-of-a-kind “Pay 1/3 card”, which allows users to split monthly spends into 3 parts, over 3 months, at 0 extra costs OR pay within 1 month for 1% cashback. They are on a mission to build consumer-centric, feature and experience rich, credit products for India.

description: Bringing AI benefits to every department
long_description: Unifyapps is a cutting-edge ‘Unified Integration Platform’ powered by generative AI, revolutionizing how enterprises connect disparate applications. Founded in 2023 by Pavitar Singh, along with a team of visionary Co-founders, Unifyapps operates globally with headquarters in India, Dubai, and the US. Unifyapps empowers enterprises to create sophisticated applications, automate business workflows, and construct robust data pipelines, catering to the needs of forward-thinking organizations worldwide. Designed for enterprise scalability and complexity, Unifyapps is at the forefront of innovation, transforming the digital landscape with its cutting-edge solutions.

description: Empowering millions of professionals worldwide to deliver services at home like never experienced before
long_description: Founded in 2014 by Abhiraj Bhal, Varun Khaitan, and Raghav Chandra, Urban Company is one of Asia's largest home services platforms. It offers services such as beauty and spa at home, cleaning, plumbing, carpentry, appliance repair, painting, and many more through its mobile app and website. Urban Company's vision is to empower millions of professionals worldwide to deliver services at home like never experienced before. We partnered with Urban Company in their earliest days as they were just launching their first website.

description: Vegapay helps financial institutions launch hyper-flexible card & credit products with lightning speed.
long_description: Vegapay is an Indian fintech startup that enables banks, NBFCs, and other institutions to launch hyper-flexible card and credit-based programs with lightning speed. Vegapay allows card issuers and co-brand partners to launch & manage highly configurable products, including credit, debit, prepaid, and forex cards, along with innovative credit-on-UPI solutions. Additionally, Vegapay offers standalone Loan Origination Systems (LOS), Co-lended Loan Management Systems (Co-LMS), and Loan Collection Systems (LCS) for financial institutions.

description: Building India’s largest B2B agritech platform for fresh fruits and vegetables
long_description: Vegrow, a B2B agri-tech platform for fruits and vegetables was founded in 2020 by IIT alumni, Praneeth Kumar, Shobhit Jain, Mrudhukar Batchu Vegrow and Kiran Naik. It is India's first agritech platform partnering with farmers to redefine and organize their supply, as well as standardize the supply chain through strategic partnerships. Despite being one of the largest sectors of the economy, the agriculture industry has been largely removed from digital disruptions. Vegrow’s aim is to make a tangible difference in the agri-tech sector by following a farmer-focused approach, creating value for the farmer community and ensuring quality produce for customers.

description: Relive the legend of Mahabharat
long_description: Virbhumi is a mobile strategy card game based on the characters of Mahabharat. It brings to life the great heroes and villains of the epic saga.

description: Vridhi Home Finance is a 'Tech-enabled Brick and Mortar' housing finance company.
long_description: Vridhi Finserv Home Finance Limited is a “Tech-enabled Brick and Mortar” housing finance company and was incorporated as a public limited company in 2022 headquartered in Bengaluru, Karnataka. They currently operate in Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh, with a network of branches spread across these regions. Vridhi was founded by seasoned promoters and founding team that have a combined mortgage experience of 75+ years in the Banking and Financial services domain.

description: India’s most loved omni channel home and living brand
long_description: Founded in 2015, Wakefit has emerged as India's leading omni-channel Sleep & Home brand. Wakefit started out by solving for the sleep category in the online space with a significantly superior and affordable mattress offering. Over time, Wakefit has evolved into an omni-channel business with offline presence through EBOs & a broader Sleep and Home brand with offerings spanning Furniture and Accessories. The company's customer backwards DNA has been it's strength from Day 1 and has led to crucial design choices including operating with a full stack model. Owning and controlling manufacturing, logistics and distribution allows Wakefit to create delightful experiences for the Indian consumer by delivering superior value at affordable prices.

description: Helping creators drive commerce
long_description: Wishlink is enabling creator-led commerce through personalized storefronts curated by influencers, with a tech stack that drives transparent and measurable attribution, and thus creator payouts. The team is building towards offering creators access to the largest selection of brands and products to work with, to maximize their earning potential. Wishlink is also building a deep product stack that solves end-to-end for brands; from inventory sharing and selection, workstream & logistics management, to performance measurement and analytics. These factors are key for brands of all scales and categories to explore creator-led sales as a scalable, profitable, and prominent growth channel. We are one of the earliest investors in Wishlink, investing in them at Seed stage.

description: E-commerce logistics company
long_description: Founded by Amitava Saha, Xpressbees is an e-commerce logistics specialist company, providing reliable and fast logistics solutions to its partners. Its extensive network reach, strong technology platform and last mile management system makes it one of the most trusted e-commerce logistics solutions provider in India.

description: Creating healthy and natural food products for the modern-day Indian consumer
long_description: Founded in 2014 by Suhasini Sampath and Anindita Sampath, Yogabar creates healthy and natural food products for the modern-day Indian consumer. The company aims to inspire and empower people to be uncompromising in their pursuit of health. With offerings across categories such as nutrition bars, breakfast cereals, and healthy snacks, Yogabar is on a mission to create healthier food options for consumers without compromising on taste.

description: Bringing wellness and mental health solutions to consumers
long_description: Yourdost is an online counselling and emotional wellness coach. Founded in 2014, Yourdost now enables individuals, colleges and corporates to avail services on their platform. With its strong focus on quality supply and maintaining user anonymity, Yourdost presents a unique proposition for consumers to openly talk about mental health and wellbeing. We supported Yourdost in 2018, believing in the team's vision.

description: Making mutual funds Sahi and Asaan for India
long_description: ZFunds is on a mission to make mutual funds Sahi* (Right) and Asaan* (Easy) for India. The company was founded by Manish Kothari and Vidhi Tuteja in 2019. ZFunds firmly believes that the human-to-human model, with technology as an enabler, is the way forward for a large segment of “digital refusers” who need guidance and expertise to handle their finances. While digital channels have emerged as the go-to channel for the industry, transaction-only platforms are challenged to increase penetration in these markets. The advisor app launched by ZFunds in 2020 provides access to the right savings and investment products to consumers pan-India. The company has over 10,000 micro-entrepreneurs advising 60,000+ customers in 600 cities and towns.

description: Developing an AI-powered finance concierge for startups
long_description: Managing startup finances has long been a complex, slow, frustrating process. This slow pace leaves founders making business-critical decisions blind, without real-time insights. Zeni was designed to meet the needs of companies ready for rapid growth. Its AI-powered finance concierge platform provides startups with fast, reliable, full-service bookkeeping, accounting, and CFO services. Zeni was founded in 2019 by Swapnil Shinde and Snehal Shinde, identical twin brothers and three-time entrepreneurs with two successful exits and over two decades of experience in building companies. Their ability to develop innovative products has attracted investors and top talent alike to join them again for this latest venture

description: Transforming how local businesses get discovered, booked, and rebooked
long_description: Founded in 2024 by IIT Kharagpur alumni Ashish Verma and Robin Chauhan, Zoca is transforming how hyperlocal service businesses get discovered, booked, and rebooked with its AI-first growth platform. Zoca's hyperlocal intelligence engine identifies neighborhood-level search trends and their comprehensive suite of AI agents manage the entire growth funnel automatically. Their agentic approach means local businesses don't just get found - they stay fully booked without lifting a finger.

description: All in 1 sales solutions for IT channel partners
long_description: Founded in 2018, Zomentum is dirupting the way software is sold to companies by IT Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and channel partners. Zomentum's product is a tightly coupled CRM, sales assessments and proposal builder with automation, analytics and integrations with an MSPs current software products. We partnered with Rahil and Shruti when the product had seen early traction with a couple of MSPs and it has been an incredible journey since then. With hundreds of happypartners across four continents, Zomentum is on its way to establish itself as a rapidly growing global leader in the MSP sales software space.

description: Democratising Access To Insurance
long_description: Zopper combines insurance and technology to deliver unique, customised, end-to-end solutions to its partners. By collaborating with top insurance providers, Zopper creates APIs designed to simplify insurance distribution, expand accessibility, and strengthen the insurance ecosystem — ultimately transforming businesses and lives.

description: Cross-chain orderbook DEX
long_description: tanX is a self-custodial, high-performance decentralized exchange (DEX) built for institutional traders, OTC desks, exchanges, banks, and brokers. It offers a reliable liquidity network with tight bid-ask spreads, low execution costs, and zero gas fees on trades.
